headline: A new TypeSafe Jev integration pack, and Censys renamed to "Censys Platform"
summary_md:
- Three packs moved on one commit each: **TypeSafeJev** (new), **SocFrameworkManager** and **Censys**.
- **TypeSafeJev** is the only new pack — 947 added lines and no deletions, so nothing existing was touched.
- **Censys** renamed its integration's display name to "Censys Platform" at pack version 3.2.2; the name shown in a tenant changes.
- **SocFrameworkManager** took the day's only fix, to how it installs a pack and confirms the installed version.

highlights.title: New pack: TypeSafe Jev integration
highlights.detail: Added whole in one commit (#46064) with 947 insertions and no deletions — a new integration rather than a change to an existing one.

highlights.title: Censys integration display name is now "Censys Platform"
highlights.detail: A rename at pack version 3.2.2 (#46042, #46067); the integration instance label users search for in the tenant changes with it.

highlights.title: SocFrameworkManager now installs the pack ZIP directly and verifies the version
highlights.detail: The largest edit of the day at 410 insertions and 29 deletions (#46050), changing how an install is performed and then checked.

items.Packs/TypeSafeJev: New pack adding the TypeSafe Jev integration, 947 lines with nothing removed.
items.Packs/SocFrameworkManager: Installs the pack ZIP directly and verifies the installed version landed.
items.Packs/Censys: Integration display name renamed to "Censys Platform" at pack version 3.2.2.
